about.title: Who am I?
about.intro: I'm a passionate full-stack developer from India with a love for creating beautiful, functional web experiences. I specialize in modern web technologies and am always eager to learn new things.
about.interests: When I'm not coding, I enjoy exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, and sharing knowledge with the developer community. I'm also interested in web design, UI/UX principles, and building products that solve real-world problems.

paragraphs: My journey into technology began with a natural curiosity about computers and a desire to explore new things. I have always been someone who enjoys creating and experimenting, which eventually led me towards web technologies and software development. I completed my Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from JSS Science and Technology University, Mysuru, and I am currently pursuing my Master of Computer Applications (MCA) from Jain University, Bengaluru, with a specialization in Cloud Computing. I am passionate about building new and creative things, learning new technologies, and continuously expanding my knowledge.

My strongest technical areas currently include Frontend Development, JavaScript, SQL, and PL/SQL, while I am actively working on strengthening my knowledge in other areas, particularly cloud technologies. Beyond technology, I have a creative side that I enjoy exploring through arts and crafts, crochet, and reading. I also value the time I spend with the people I love. I believe that creativity is not limited to one field—it is a way of thinking that can be applied to both technology and life. My personal philosophy is simple: 'You can, if you think you can.' I believe that confidence, determination, and the willingness to learn can take us further than we initially imagine.

journeyIntro: My journey into the world of technology has been shaped by curiosity, determination, and a desire to create something of my own. From the beginning of my educational journey, I was interested in computers and technology. I was also one of the brighter students in my class and always had a curiosity to explore new things. I would describe myself as an ambivert—someone who can enjoy both social interactions and personal time.

journey.title: The Beginning
journey.subTitle: Stepping into the world of Computer Science
journey.description: After completing school, I had the grades to pursue engineering and could have joined a good engineering college. However, I chose a different path. I decided to pursue a Bachelor of Computer Applications, even though BCA is often considered by many as a secondary choice compared to engineering. For me, it was a conscious decision.
journey.description2: I wanted to prove that I could build a successful career with the path I had chosen. I did not want my degree to define my limitations. Instead, I wanted my skills, hard work, and determination to define what I could achieve. During my BCA journey, I became aware that engineering students often had greater exposure to certain technologies and opportunities. Rather than regretting my decision, I saw it as a challenge. I wanted to achieve everything I could with the degree I had chosen and create my own opportunities. That mindset pushed me to work harder and eventually helped me secure an on-campus internship at Ellucian.

story: It started with curiosity about computers and how things work. After school I had the grades to pursue engineering, but I chose a different path: a Bachelor of Computer Applications at JSS Science and Technology University, Mysuru. It was a conscious decision, and I did not want my degree to define my limitations.

Today I work as an Associate Technical Consultant at Ellucian Higher Education Solutions in Bengaluru, and I am pursuing my Master of Computer Applications in Cloud Computing at Jain University. Frontend development, JavaScript, SQL and PL/SQL are where I feel strongest, and I am steadily building my knowledge of cloud technologies.

Away from the screen I make things by hand through arts and crafts and crochet, I read, and I watch anime. I also value the time I spend with the people I love. I believe creativity is not limited to one field, and my philosophy is simple: you can, if you think you can.

footer.quote: You can, if you think you can!
